coordinate_system: unit ICRS sphere mapped to Three [x,z,y]

provenance.proper_motion: unit-sphere tangent velocity * elapsed Julian years, then normalize; no radial motion or parallax
provenance.temperature: Ballesteros (2012), EPL 97 34008; B-V formula valid display approximation; missing/out-of-domain colour neutral
provenance.colour: Planck spectrum integrated against Wyman et al. 2013 analytic CIE 1931 approximations, normalized sRGB
